postprocess_config.anchor_rule: one distinct numeric C coordinate within radius; conflicting coordinates leave free corner fixed
postprocess_config.degenerate_rule: free only: exact repeated coordinate or exactly zero FP64 cross product
postprocess_config.duplicate_rule: free only: same three numeric coordinates ignoring winding; C wins, then first retained free source face
postprocess_config.free_rule: lexicographic original-point representatives; nearest existing representative within radius; no transitive unions or means
postprocess_config.known_vertex_identity: FP32 coordinate bytes, including signed zero
postprocess_config.normalization: NONE; never normalize the generated bbox
postprocess_config.radius_limit: Single engineering threshold; original paper runtime units are not fully traceable

parameters.width_transform: multiply x coordinate FP32 about origin, C/Y jointly
parameters.precision: BF16 forward, FP32 parameters/sum/loss; strict deterministic; TF32 off; SDPA math; unpadded mask=None

objective: sum free coordinate squared errors / (9 * sum batch free face counts); no other terms
role: 1024D zero e_known added in activation dtype after post_quant_linear, trainable anchor only; no-role zero buffer and zero marker
checkpoint_policy: 500 recovery only,1000 unique endpoint; no best selection
failure_policy: No silent replay of unresolved model/optimizer calls. Stop and preserve failures on OOM/nonfinite/data/asset problems. Three-hour cumulative GPU process cap.
limitations: Six repeatedly inspected USER DEV conditions, no independent test. Source-supported interface is descriptive reference, not required user interface.
output_guard: All runtime outputs resolve inside current OUT and reject lexical symlink ancestors; atomic writes; old inputs hashes before/after

pre_gpu_implementation_revision.reason: Fix absolute package import; verify/recover final inference export after full checkpoint before skip
